At the 1024x1536 output size, keep the center of the bottom doorway/plinth near x=510, and move the center of the top small domed cap to approximately x=565 to x=575: about 55–65 pixels rightward over the full tower height. Shift progressively through the storeys, so it is the whole built tower that leans, not only the cap. Keep the ground line level and the footing grounded; do not rotate the whole canvas or create a sloping horizon. The tilt should be clearly visible on inspection yet gentle, not cartoonish and not on the point of collapse.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE from image 1: exactly SEVEN storeys with all seven opening bands; the uppermost plain rebuilt storey and low small domed cap; the tapering octagonal brick mass; corbelled brick eaves and platforms; delicate bracket outlines and lobed door arches; selective sparse brick marks; full base and all contours. Do not add wooden roofs, extra floors, a tall finial, trees, people, damage or new ornament. Keep the composition centered overall with every part completely inside the portrait frame. Preserve the exact thin black line style, white surfaces and pure white background, no shading, no fill, no gray tones, no text, no border. The ONLY intended difference is the approximately 2–3 degree rightward structural lean, while the seven-storey geometry stays intact.

historical_sources.supports: 塔959年始建、961年落成，七层八面，国保五代口径；倾斜与历次修缮应和创建纪年区分。

site_recommendation.name: 虎丘云岩寺塔
site_recommendation.year_note: 960仅为959—961施工区间的排序中点；国保列五代，吴越政权延续至978，不能因961已入北宋年号而改归宋塔。
site_recommendation.place: 江苏 · 苏州 · 虎丘
site_recommendation.lede: 虎丘山顶的云岩寺塔层层砖檐逐级收分，七层塔身保留仿木构的柱、枋与斗栱痕迹。塔的倾斜与砖木结构的历次变化，共同构成苏州这座古塔的现貌。
facts: 现塔始建于959年、落成于961年，国保年代列五代，历史归属吴越。
塔为七层八面仿木楼阁式砖塔，木檐毁失后保留砖檐与平座结构。
塔身长期向一侧倾斜；历代修缮及近现代加固与原塔建造年代分别记录。

quality_check.notes: 复核七个塔身层位、现状低顶和完整基座；塔顶相对底层门中心轻微右移，方向与实拍一致，地面保持水平。未添加木檐或填黑阴影。
